title: Une application pratique, à quelles conditions ?
titleEn: A useful app, under what conditions?
summary: A nonprofit weighs the convenience of a digital booking tool against privacy, access and support for people without reliable internet.

sentences.fr: Une association voulait remplacer son formulaire papier par un outil de réservation en ligne.
sentences.en: An association wanted to replace its paper form with an online booking tool.

sentences.fr: L'outil permettrait aux membres de choisir une heure sans téléphoner, ce qui simplifierait certaines demandes.
sentences.en: The tool would let members choose a time without calling, which would simplify some requests.

sentences.fr: Toutefois, le comité ignorait combien de renseignements personnels seraient conservés et pendant combien de temps.
sentences.en: However, the committee did not know how much personal information would be stored or for how long.

sentences.fr: Une bénévole a aussi rappelé que certains membres utilisaient un téléphone partagé ou une connexion limitée.
sentences.en: A volunteer also noted that some members used a shared phone or had limited internet access.

sentences.fr: L'association a demandé au fournisseur comment supprimer les dossiers, limiter les accès et offrir une solution hors ligne.
sentences.en: The association asked the provider how to delete records, limit access and offer an offline option.

sentences.fr: Le fournisseur a répondu à deux questions, mais n'a pas encore confirmé la durée de conservation.
sentences.en: The provider answered two questions but had not yet confirmed the retention period.

sentences.fr: Le comité a reporté sa décision jusqu'à ce que cette information soit claire et qu'une option sans téléphone soit prévue.
sentences.en: The committee postponed its decision until that information was clear and an option without a phone was planned.
sentences.note: A digital service should be evaluated for privacy and for people who cannot use its preferred device or connection.

quiz.prompt: What was one expected benefit of the online tool?
options: Every member already had reliable internet
Members could choose a time without calling
The association could stop offering appointments
All personal data would disappear automatically
quiz.explain: The second sentence states the expected convenience.

quiz.prompt: What information had the provider not confirmed?
options: How long records would be kept
Whether the tool had a calendar
quiz.explain: The sixth sentence names the unanswered retention question.

quiz.prompt: Why did the committee delay its decision?
options: The tool had already been installed
It still needed clear data-retention information and a non-phone option
The members had rejected every digital service
quiz.explain: The final sentence gives both conditions for deciding.
